age_limit.details: Not exceeding 45 years as on the date of document verification and interview.

qualification.details: Candidates must possess the academic qualification, teaching, and research experience as per the latest guidelines of NMC (National Medical Commission), stipulated in Gazette Notification No. CG-DL-E-05072025-264399 dated 30.06.2025.

salary_details.senior resident: Fixed Basic Pay of Rs. 67,700/- (Level 11) + Other Allowances*
salary_details.details: Other allowances include NPA, DA, HRA, TA, and DA on TA. The approximate total remuneration on date is Rs. 139462.

how_to_apply: Download the application form from the official notification.
Fill out the application form with correct details.
Send the completed application along with MCI/SMC Number, contact number, and self-attested dossiers via email to [email protected] prior to the interview.
Attend the walk-in interview directly with all relevant original and self-attested copies of documents without any prior application, although emailing in advance is required.
important_instructions: Candidates who will be able to join immediately will be preferred. Number of vacancies is provisional and may increase or decrease depending on actual requirement. No TA/DA will be paid to the candidates for appearing in the interview. Canvassing in any form shall be disqualification. Hostel accommodation/quarters will not be provided. Selected candidates will have to furnish a DD/Bankers Cheque for Rs. 30,000/- drawn in favour of "ESIC Fund Account No. 1" payable at Guwahati towards security deposit. If the selected candidate resigns/terminates contract within 09 months of commencement with or without prior notice, the security deposit of Rs. 30,000/- will be forfeited. No Private practice is allowed during the tenure of service in ESIC.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Medical College and Hospital, Beltola Senior Resident Walk-in Interview Date, Time and Venue
content_sections.text: Register for Job Alerts Employees' State Insurance Corporation Medical College & Hospital, Beltola, Guwahati is recruiting candidates for 32 Senior Resident vacancies on a contract basis. Eligible applicants can attend the walk-in interview on 30 October 2026, reporting at 9:00 AM at the Chamber of the Dean, ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Beltola, Guwahati. Candidates must fill the application form and send self-attested dossiers via email along with MCI/SMC Number and contact number, and attend the walk-in selection process. The notified pay for the posts is Rs. 67,700 (Level 11) with fixed basic pay and other allowances. The selection process consists of Document Verification followed by a Walk-in Interview.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Medical College and Hospital, Beltola Senior Resident Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: Total vacancies: 32. Category-wise break-up: UR - 7, OBC - 11, SC - 7, ST - 1, EWS - 6.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility and Qualification
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess the academic qualification, teaching, and research experience as per the latest guidelines of NMC (National Medical Commission), stipulated in Gazette Notification No. CG-DL-E-05072025-264399 dated 30.06.2025.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Not exceeding 45 years as on the date of document verification and interview.

content_sections.heading: Salary and Allowances
content_sections.text: Other allowances include NPA, DA, HRA, TA, and DA on TA. The approximate total remuneration on date is Rs. 139462.

rows.pay_level_pay: Fixed Basic Pay of Rs. 67,700/- (Level 11) + Other Allowances*

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Age Proof (Class 10th certificate / Birth certificate) MBBS Certificate PG Degree / Diploma Certificate MCI/SMC Registration Certificate with MD/MS/DNB qualification M.Sc Certificate (For Anatomy, Physiology, Biochemistry & Statistics) with PhD degree (if required) BCME & BCBR Certificate wherever necessary Two Recent Passport size Photographs Caste Certificate for SC/ST/OBC & I&A Certificate for EWS candidates (OBC candidates must submit latest OBC Certificate as per Central Govt. Proforma, not more than One year old from the date of interview) No Objection Certificate from present employer, if applicable Experience Certificate, wherever applicable

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Candidates must report for document verification between 09:00 AM and 09:30 AM at the Chamber of the Dean, ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Beltola, Guwahati-781022. Only candidates whose documents are verified successfully will be allowed to attend the walk-in interview.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Download the application form from the official notification. Fill out the application form with correct details. Send the completed application along with MCI/SMC Number, contact number, and self-attested dossiers via email to [email protected] prior to the interview. Attend the walk-in interview directly with all relevant original and self-attested copies of documents without any prior application, although emailing in advance is required.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates who will be able to join immediately will be preferred. Number of vacancies is provisional and may increase or decrease depending on actual requirement. No TA/DA will be paid to the candidates for appearing in the interview. Canvassing in any form shall be disqualification. Hostel accommodation/quarters will not be provided. Selected candidates will have to furnish a DD/Bankers Cheque for Rs. 30,000/- drawn in favour of "ESIC Fund Account No. 1" payable at Guwahati towards security deposit. If the selected candidate resigns/terminates contract within 09 months of commencement with or without prior notice, the security deposit of Rs. 30,000/- will be forfeited. No Private practice is allowed during the tenure of service in ESIC.

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for ESIC Beltola Senior Resident recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held on 30 October 2026 (Friday).

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time for the document verification?
faq.answer: Candidates must report between 09:00 AM and 09:30 AM.

faq.question: Q3. Where is the venue for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The interview will take place at the Chamber of the Dean, ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Beltola, Guwahati-781022.

faq.question: Q4. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are 32 vacancies available for Senior Residents.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is not exceeding 45 years as on the date of document verification and interview.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly salary for Senior Residents?
faq.answer: The pay is Fixed Basic Pay of Rs. 67,700/- (Level 11) plus other allowances, with approximate total remuneration of Rs. 139462.

faq.question: Q7. What email address should be used to send application dossiers?
faq.answer: Applications and self-attested dossiers must be emailed to [email protected].

faq.question: Q8. Is there any security deposit required upon appointment?
faq.answer: Yes, selected candidates must furnish a DD/Bankers Cheque for Rs. 30,000/- drawn in favour of ESI Fund Account No. 1 towards a security deposit.
